terms.comment: We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections. It is known as a rule of canon law: the rules of law in the Liber Sextus include Quī tacet cōnsentīre vidētur (rule 43, as reference works give it; we have not read it in an edition).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
